# login validates live, echoes the org and user, stores the URL in
# config.json and the token in a 0600 file with --no-keychain — and the
# stored credentials power later calls with the env empty.

env FULCRUM_API_TOKEN=
env FULCRUM_URL=

fulcrum -in login-input.txt login --no-keychain
grep 'settings/developer' last-stdout.txt
grep 'Connected to Corpus Primary Organization' last-stdout.txt
grep 'developer@corpus.usefulcrum.test' last-stdout.txt
grep 'token in file' last-stdout.txt
grep '"url"' config/config.json
! grep 'corpus-token' config/config.json
exists config/token

fulcrum projects
grep 'Fulcrum Dogfood' last-stdout.txt

# A wrong token never gets stored: validation fails first.
fulcrum -code 2 -in bad-login-input.txt login --no-keychain
grep 'unauthorized' last-stderr.txt

-- login-input.txt --
$SRV_URL
corpus-token
-- bad-login-input.txt --
$SRV_URL
not-the-token
